scheduling_assumptions.conditions: CANN motivates independent queues. Exact original-910 arbitration and L0C export mapping are uncalibrated. l0c_export is a separate proxy queue; services are non-preemptive and reserve resources for their full duration.

assumptions: Configured Cube/local/L2 services retain provenance. HBM rate is derived from bandwidth, core count and clock; L2 capacity and byte/cycle rate are equally partitioned. Required unknown inputs fail.

HBM fetch/output/bypass share one allocated service; L2 fill/read share another. Cold panel misses fetch, fill, then read serially. Input requests complete in program order; compute/output may overlap. Clean input eviction has no writeback; C bypasses L2.
A/B copies share MTE1 by default. L1 slots are released after both operands' last reads; L0C holds the entire K reduction.
Zero configured startup allowances omit uncalibrated fixed latency; each modeled transfer charges its configured allowance. The model is not a calibrated physical upper/lower bound.
Assumed service values remain assumed in hardware provenance and derived specification peaks; missing required services fail.

service_cycles.semantics: Sum of modeled stage service work; stages may overlap. Not elapsed time or a sum of resource busy cycles.

elapsed_cycles.semantics: Disjoint elapsed-time partition; available stages sum to timing.total_cycles. No overlap is charged twice.
elapsed_cycles.reason: The pipeline computes total duration but does not attribute overlapping intervals to disjoint stages.

energy.reason: Issue 2 supplies action inputs; coefficients and energy evaluation are separate work.

vector_service.conditions: Standalone compute occupancy, not full operator latency. Rates share one core budget and cannot be added. No transfers, reductions, dependency scheduling, vector tail/issue overhead or special-function startup. FP32 denotes operand format, not correctly rounded exp/rsqrt accuracy. GEMM accumulates in Cube/L0C and does not invoke this service. Unit/core inventory changes do not automatically scale the configured budget.

vector.base_ops_per_cycle.version: Ascend Vector algorithmic reference v1; 2026-11-18 America/Los_Angeles
vector.base_ops_per_cycle.conditions: Published vector width is 256 bytes. Assume one 256-byte group of 32-bit scalar-element basic operations per cycle: 256/4=64. Width alone does not establish throughput; one group/cycle is an uncalibrated model assumption, not native instruction latency or measured sustained performance. All supported operations share this fixed per-core budget; do not multiply it by Vector units or architectural core count. Transfers and instruction/tail overhead are omitted.

vector.int32_add_cost.version: Ascend Vector algorithmic reference v1; 2026-11-18 America/Los_Angeles
vector.int32_add_cost.conditions: One scalar-element INT32 add consumes one equivalent basic operation. Standalone service only: GEMM K accumulation is already included in Cube MACs and does not execute a separate Vector add.

vector.fp32_basic_op_cost.version: Ascend Vector algorithmic reference v1; 2026-11-18 America/Los_Angeles
vector.fp32_basic_op_cost.conditions: One scalar-element FP32 ADD or MUL consumes one equivalent operation. Same work convention as TSP; not measured parity with INT32. FMA, DIV, casts, reductions and complete activation operators are not implicitly supported.

vector.fp32_exp_cost.version: Ascend Vector algorithmic reference v1; 2026-11-18 America/Los_Angeles
vector.fp32_exp_cost.conditions: TSP-compatible algorithmic proxy: k=round(x*log2(e)), r=x-k*ln(2) costs 4 equivalent operations; degree-5 Taylor polynomial in Horner form costs 5 MUL + 5 ADD; exponent scaling costs 1, total 15. Round/scaling each count as one equivalent operation; no FMA discount. Reference domain finite x in [-80,0]. Work accounting only, no numerical evaluation or correctly-rounded FP32 accuracy claim. Not native Ascend Exp instruction throughput/latency. Shares Vector budget; no independent SFU.

vector.fp32_rsqrt_cost.version: Ascend Vector algorithmic reference v1; 2026-11-18 America/Los_Angeles
vector.fp32_rsqrt_cost.conditions: Positive-normal FP32 approximation work proxy: bit seed bits(y)=0x5f3759df-(bits(x)>>1) costs 2 (shift and subtraction; bit reinterpretation costs 0), then two iterations y=(0.5*y)*(3-x*y*y), each 4 MUL + 1 SUB, total 12. No fused-operation discount. No correctly-rounded FP32 or exceptional-value accuracy claim. This analytical service counts work only, does not evaluate rsqrt numerically, and is not native Ascend RSqrt instruction throughput or latency. Shares the Vector budget; memory and dependencies are separate. No independent SFU.

output_path.description: Model a packed INT32 L0C->UB->HBM export service. Source supports L0C/vector/UB dataflow, but exact raw INT32 export instruction sequence and service still require target/CANN validation.

limitations: Single-core coarse analytical estimate; chip peak is specification arithmetic only.
Panel-level LRU and analytical FIFO scheduling; no cache lines, set associativity, bank/NoC/DRAM contention or cross-core scheduling.
Cold, equally partitioned read-only input cache; outputs bypass. Oversize panels bypass without allocation. These policies are assumptions, not original-910 hardware behavior.
HBM/L2 actions count padded payload, not physical transactions. Store-and-forward fetch/fill/read and omitted local DMA port limits require calibration.
Cube throughput includes MAC accumulation; there is no extra fixed Accumulate cycle.
INT32 export path and assumed capacities require target validation.
No host launch, layout conversion, full-model execution, energy or area prediction.

execution_contract.source: Project analytical execution policy; ARCHITECTURE.md execution contract
execution_contract.conditions: Explicit software modeling assumptions, not measured hardware behavior. Byte/cycle service budgets are allocated separately from chip inventory. CLI/API overrides are recorded in the effective execution contract. Fixed latencies use cycles; zero omits an uncalibrated allowance. Output-block/wave barriers and ideal input sharing remain declared approximations. L2 input panels use cold LRU, all chip capacity equally partitioned, no idle share borrowing. L2 fills and reads share the allocated bandwidth. Requests complete in program order; misses fetch/fill/read serially; C and oversize inputs bypass L2. No cache-line, bank, associativity or cross-core contention model.

issued.basis: padded arithmetic; 2 operations per MAC; excludes inactive unused arrays

work_counts.semantics: Views of existing counts, not additional additive actions. Logical payload is not a physical memory transaction. Unknown internal activity is not zero.

io_contract.name_scope: Within one operator call; graph callers must qualify names by node identity.
io_contract.intermediate_residency: No UB/VMEM/register retention across operator calls is promised.
io_contract.conversion: No implicit cast, dequantization or requantization; stored dtype is binding.
io_contract.traffic: Standalone actions already include each block's boundary accesses; connections do not remove them.
